eventMetadata.context_description: In the 2026 NCAA Tournament Final Four semifinal at Lucas Oil Stadium, trader consensus slightly favored the No. 1 seed Michigan Wolverines over the No. 1 seed Arizona Wildcats in a razor-close matchup, reflecting both teams' elite tournament paths. Michigan's explosive offense, averaging 90+ points across four NCAA games led by frontcourt trio Aday Mara, Yaxel Lendeborg, and Morez Johnson Jr., drove optimism despite guard depth concerns without torn-ACL victim L.J. Cason and backup PG issues. Arizona countered with a 14-2 straight-up record versus ranked foes, superior backcourt play from Jaden Bradley and Brayden Burries, and offensive rebounding edge (+3.4 extra chances per game). Foul trouble risks for bigs and perimeter execution loomed as key swings pre-tip.
